cases.sentence: Мой ___ разбит, мои дни угасли, мне грозит могила.
cases.explain: Дух is the subject of the sentence, requiring the nominative case.

cases.sentence: О, земля, не скрывай мою ___, пусть не найдет покоя мой крик.
cases.explain: The transitive verb скрывай (hide) takes the direct object in the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Мой заступник на ___, мой свидетель в вышине.
cases.explain: The preposition на (in/on) indicating location governs the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Мой заступник защитит меня перед ___, как человек защищает в суде своего друга.
cases.explain: The preposition перед (before) governing agency requires the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Моим годам приходит ___, я ухожу в путь безвозвратный.
cases.explain: Конец is the subject that 'comes' to the years, requiring nominative case.

cases.sentence: Я становлюсь сам себе в посмешище, и дети видят мой ___.
cases.explain: The transitive verb видят (see) takes the direct object in the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Честные люди приходят в ужас от ___.
cases.explain: The preposition от (from/at) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Праведник удержится в своем ___ и только крепнет в силе.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) indicating position governs the prepositional case.

reading.ru: О, земля, не скрывай мою кровь, пусть не найдет покоя мой крик.
reading.question: What does Job appeal to the earth to do?
options: Not to hide his blood and not to silence his cry
reading.correct: Not to hide his blood and not to silence his cry
reading.explain: Job cries О, земля, не скрывай мою кровь, пусть не найдет покоя мой крик — 'Oh, earth, do not cover my blood, and let my cry find no resting place.'

reading.ru: Но даже теперь мой свидетель на небесах, и есть в вышине у меня защитник.
reading.question: What comfort does Job find in his suffering?
options: He has a witness in heaven and a defender on high
reading.correct: He has a witness in heaven and a defender on high
reading.explain: Job says Но даже теперь мой свидетель на небесах, и есть в вышине у меня защитник — 'But even now my witness is in heaven; my advocate is on high.'

reading.ru: Мой заступник, друг мой, к Богу слезы мои текут.
reading.question: What does Job say about his tears?
options: His tears flow to God as his helper and friend
reading.correct: His tears flow to God as his helper and friend
reading.explain: Job speaks of his advocate and friend, saying that his tears flow to God in prayer.

reading.ru: Мой заступник защитит меня перед Богом, как человек защищает в суде своего друга.
reading.question: How does Job say his helper will defend him?
options: As a man defends his friend before a judge
reading.correct: As a man defends his friend before a judge
reading.explain: Job states Мой заступник защитит меня перед Богом, как человек защищает в суде своего друга — 'My helper will defend me before God, as a man defends his friend in court.'

reading.ru: Моим годам приходит конец, я ухожу в путь безвозвратный.
reading.question: What does Job say about his future?
options: His days are ending and he goes on the path of no return
He will be healed and restored
reading.correct: His days are ending and he goes on the path of no return
reading.explain: Job laments Моим годам приходит конец, я ухожу в путь безвозвратный — 'My years draw to an end, and I go on the path of no return.'

reading.ru: Честные люди приходят в ужас от этого, и невинный воздымает руки против нечестивца.
reading.question: How do righteous people react to Job's fate?
options: They are astonished and the innocent raises his hand against the wicked
reading.correct: They are astonished and the innocent raises his hand against the wicked
reading.explain: The text indicates that righteous people are shocked by Job's suffering and respond by standing against those who oppress the innocent.
